requirements.title: Colombia veterinary health certificate (examined within 10 days)

manual_checklist.title: Pit-bull-type breeds are prohibited
manual_checklist.detail: Colombia prohibits the import of pit-bull-type breeds. Confirm your dog's breed is not on the restricted list before booking travel.

manual_checklist.title: Rabies: first-time dose ≥21 days before shipment, pet 15 weeks or older
manual_checklist.detail: The certificate requires the animal to be 15 weeks of age or older to enter on the rabies-vaccinated pathway. For a first-time rabies vaccination, the dose must have been given at least 21 days before the shipment date. An on-time booster with no lapse has no wait. (Animals under 15 weeks follow the unvaccinated / home-quarantine pathway below instead.)

manual_checklist.title: Under 15 weeks: unvaccinated entry requires a home quarantine
manual_checklist.detail: Animals under 15 weeks of age may enter without a rabies vaccination, but entry is conditional on a home quarantine, during which the pet must be vaccinated against rabies by a private veterinarian or zootechnical veterinary doctor with professional registration, using vaccines registered by ICA in Colombia. Obtain and retain that documentation, then tick this off. (This item only appears for under-15-week pets.)

manual_checklist.title: Antiparasitic treatment within 60 days of shipment
manual_checklist.detail: Internal + external antiparasitic treatment is mandatory for both cats and dogs and must be applied within 60 days prior to shipment, recorded on the certificate (product name, active ingredient, and administration date for each).

manual_checklist.title: Entry certificate (CIS) issued at the airport
manual_checklist.detail: Accompanied pets do NOT need a pre-arrival ICA import permit; ICA issues the CIS (Certificado de Inspección Sanitaria) at the airport on arrival.

sources.page_title: ICA reglamenta la salida y entrada de mascotas (Res. 2656/2019)
sources.applies_to: dog/cat import to Colombia, accompanied pet
supporting_requirements: CIS issued at the airport (no pre-arrival permit)

sources.page_title: Pet Travel From the United States to Colombia
supporting_requirements: Form 7001 USDA-endorsed within 10 days of travel

sources.page_title: Pet Travel From the United States to Colombia (last modified 2026-03-05)
supporting_requirements: the certificate is the Colombia-specific International Health Certificate (https://www.aphis.usda.gov/sites/default/files/colombia-dog-cat.pdf), not Form 7001

sources.page_title: Veterinary Health Certificate for Export of Dogs and Cats from the United States of America to Colombia
sources.applies_to: US-origin dog/cat export to Colombia — the certificate itself
supporting_requirements: "The examination must be conducted within 10 days prior to shipment." (p.3, Certification Statement 1)

"The minimum age for the entry of a rabies vaccinated pet to Colombia is 15 weeks." / "the vaccination must have been given at least 21 days before the date of shipment" for a first-time rabies vaccination (p.3, Certification Statement 2a)

"The shipment contains animal(s) less than 15 weeks of age... The entry of these animals into the country will be conditional on the pets' undergoing a home quarantine, during which they must be vaccinated against rabies by a private veterinarian or zootechnical veterinary doctor with professional registration and with vaccines that are registered by the ICA in the country." (p.3, Certification Statement 2b)
"This treatment is mandatory for cats and dogs. Parasite treatment must be applied within 60 days prior to shipment." (p.5, Parasite Treatment Information)
